shortDescription: Create and manage block Volume on the Hetzner Cloud.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_endpoint_hetzner
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner API. You can also set this option by using the C(HETZNER_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The token for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: format
options.description: Automatically Format the volume on creation Can only be used in case the Volume does not exist.

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of the Hetzner Cloud Block Volume to manage. Only required if no volume I(name) is given

options.name: location
options.description: Location of the Hetzner Cloud Volume. Required if no I(server) is given and Volume does not exist.

options.name: name
options.description: The Name of the Hetzner Cloud Block Volume to manage. Only required if no volume I(id) is given or a volume does not exist.

options.name: server
options.description: Server Name the Volume should be assigned to. Required if no I(location) is given and Volume does not exist.

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the Block Volume in GB. Required if volume does not yet exists.
